cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a present-day miniature puppet-theatre repair studio — she carefully untangles two puppet-control rings from an overhead hook; a training gym with a heavy bag — standing; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — kneeling on the ground; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — perched on a ledge or edge; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
